verses.original: מַֽעַרְכֵי־ לֵ֑ב לְאָדָ֥ם מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן׃ וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: ma·‘ar·ḵê- lêḇ lə·’ā·ḏām ma·‘ă·nêh lā·šō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: The plans of the heart belong to man but the reply of the tongue [is] from the LORD

verses.original: כָּֽל־ אִ֭ישׁ דַּרְכֵי־ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו רוּח֣וֹת וְתֹכֵ֖ן יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš dar·ḵê- zaḵ bə·‘ê·nāw rū·ḥō·wṯ wə·ṯō·ḵên Yah·weh
verses.literal: All a man’s ways [are] pure in his own eyes but his motives are weighed out by the LORD

verses.original: גֹּ֣ל מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ
verses.transliteration: gōl ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā ’el- Yah·weh maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wə·yik·kō·nū
verses.literal: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה פָּעַ֣ל כֹּ֤ל לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם־ רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh pā·‘al kōl lam·ma·‘ă·nê·hū wə·ḡam- rā·šā‘ lə·yō·wm rā·‘āh
verses.literal: The LORD has made everything for His purpose even the wicked for the day of disaster

verses.original: כָּל־ גְּבַהּ־ לֵ֑ב תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- gə·ḇah- lêḇ tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh yāḏ lə·yāḏ lō yin·nā·qeh
verses.literal: Everyone [who is] proud in heart is detestable to the LORD be assured that . . . he will not go unpunished

verses.original: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת עָוֺ֑ן יְכֻפַּ֣ר וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ ‘ā·wōn yə·ḵup·par ū·ḇə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh sūr mê·rā‘
verses.literal: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for and by the fear of the LORD [one] turns aside from evil

verses.original: אִ֑ישׁ דַּרְכֵי־ בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה גַּם־ א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš dar·ḵê- bir·ṣō·wṯ Yah·weh gam- ’ō·wy·ḇāw yaš·lim ’it·tōw
verses.literal: When a man’s ways please the LORD He makes even [the man’s] enemies live at peace with him

verses.original: טוֹב־ מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- mə·‘aṭ biṣ·ḏā·qāh mê·rōḇ tə·ḇū·’ō·wṯ bə·lō miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Better a little with righteousness than great gain with injustice . . .

verses.original: אָ֭דָם לֵ֣ב יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām lêḇ yə·ḥaš·šêḇ dar·kōw Yah·weh yā·ḵîn ṣa·‘ă·ḏōw
verses.literal: A man’s heart plans his course but the LORD determines his steps

verses.original: קֶ֤סֶם׀ עַֽל־ שִׂפְתֵי־ מֶ֑לֶךְ פִּֽיו׃ לֹ֣א יִמְעַל־ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט
verses.transliteration: qe·sem ‘al- śip̄·ṯê- me·leḵ pîw lō yim·‘al- bə·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: A divine verdict is on the lips of a king his mouth must not betray justice

verses.original: מִ֭שְׁפָּט פֶּ֤לֶס׀ וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י לַֽיהוָ֑ה כָּל־ אַבְנֵי־ כִֽיס׃ מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ
verses.transliteration: miš·pāṭ pe·les ū·mō·zə·nê Yah·weh kāl- ’aḇ·nê- ḵîs ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: Honest scales and balances [are from] the LORD all the weights in the bag are His concern

verses.original: רֶ֑שַׁע עֲשׂ֣וֹת תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים כִּ֥י כִּסֵּֽא׃ יִכּ֥וֹן בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: re·ša‘ ‘ă·śō·wṯ tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ mə·lā·ḵîm kî kis·sê yik·kō·wn ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Wicked behavior is detestable for kings for a throne is established through righteousness

verses.original: צֶ֑דֶק שִׂפְתֵי־ מְ֭לָכִים רְצ֣וֹן וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ṣe·ḏeq śip̄·ṯê- mə·lā·ḵîm rə·ṣō·wn wə·ḏō·ḇêr yə·šā·rîm ye·’ĕ·hāḇ
verses.literal: Righteous lips are a king’s delight and he who speaks honestly is beloved

verses.original: חֲמַת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־ מָ֑וֶת חָכָ֣ם וְאִ֖ישׁ יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·maṯ- me·leḵ mal·’ă·ḵê- mā·weṯ ḥā·ḵām wə·’îš yə·ḵap·pə·ren·nāh
verses.literal: The wrath of a king is a messenger of death but a wise man will pacify it

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ פְּנֵי־ בְּאוֹר־ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ pə·nê- bə·’ō·wr- ḥay·yîm ū·rə·ṣō·w·nōw kə·‘āḇ mal·qō·wōš
verses.literal: When a king’s face brightens there is life his favor is like a rain cloud in spring

verses.original: מַה־ טּ֥וֹב קְֽנֹה־ חָכְמָ֗ה מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ṭō·wḇ qə·nōh- ḥāḵ·māh mê·ḥā·rūṣ ū·qə·nō·wṯ bî·nāh niḇ·ḥār mik·kā·sep̄
verses.literal: How much better to acquire wisdom than gold To gain understanding is more desirable than silver

verses.original: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃ שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: mə·sil·laṯ yə·šā·rîm sūr mê·rā‘ nō·ṣêr dar·kōw šō·mêr nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: The highway of the upright leads away from evil he who guards his way protects his life

verses.original: גָּא֑וֹן לִפְנֵי־ שֶׁ֥בֶר גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃ וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן
verses.transliteration: gā·’ō·wn lip̄·nê- še·ḇer gō·ḇah rū·aḥ wə·lip̄·nê ḵiš·šā·lō·wn
verses.literal: Pride goes before destruction and a haughty spirit before a fall

verses.original: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל־ ר֭וּחַ אֶת־ עֲנִיִּים מֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת־ גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ šə·p̄al- rū·aḥ ’eṯ- ʿă·nī·yīm mê·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl ’eṯ- gê·’îm
verses.literal: It is better to be lowly in spirit among the humble than to divide the spoil with the proud

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל־ דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא־ ט֑וֹב אַשְׁרָֽיו׃ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl ‘al- dā·ḇār yim·ṣā- ṭō·wḇ ’aš·rāw ū·ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Whoever heeds . . . instruction will find success and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD

verses.original: לַחֲכַם־ לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.transliteration: la·ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ yiq·qā·rê nā·ḇō·wn ū·me·ṯeq śə·p̲ā·t̲a·yim yō·sîp̄ le·qaḥ
verses.literal: The wise in heart are called discerning and pleasant speech promotes instruction

verses.original: שֵׂ֣כֶל מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: śê·ḵel mə·qō·wr ḥay·yîm bə·‘ā·lāw ū·mū·sar ’ĕ·wi·lîm ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessor but the discipline of fools is folly

verses.original: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃ וְעַל־ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ḥā·ḵām yaś·kîl pî·hū yō·sîp̄ le·qaḥ wə·‘a·lś- śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw
verses.literal: The heart of the wise [man] instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips

verses.original: נֹ֑עַם אִמְרֵי־ צוּף־ דְּ֭בַשׁ מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.transliteration: nō·‘am ’im·rê- ṣūp̄- də·ḇaš mā·ṯō·wq lan·ne·p̄eš ū·mar·pê lā·‘ā·ṣem
verses.literal: Pleasant words are a honeycomb . . . sweet to the soul and healing to the bones

verses.original: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־ מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: yêš de·reḵ yā·šār lip̄·nê- ’îš wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh dar·ḵê- mā·weṯ
verses.literal: There is a way that seems right to a man but its end is the way of death

verses.original: עָ֭מֵל נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ פִּֽיהוּ׃ אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·mêl ne·p̄eš ‘ā·mə·lāh lōw kî- pî·hū ’ā·ḵap̄ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: A worker’s appetite works for him because his hunger drives him onward

verses.original: בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אִ֣ישׁ כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל־ שְׂפָתָיו צָרָֽבֶת׃ כְּאֵ֣שׁ
verses.transliteration: bə·lî·ya·‘al ’îš kō·reh rā·‘āh wə·‘al- śə·p̄å̄·ṯå̄w ṣā·rā·ḇeṯ kə·’êš
verses.literal: A worthless man digs up evil vvv and his speech is like a scorching fire

verses.original: תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת אִ֣ישׁ יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ ’îš yə·šal·laḥ mā·ḏō·wn wə·nir·gå̄n map̄·rîḏ ’al·lūp̄
verses.literal: A perverse man spreads dissension and a gossip divides close friends

verses.original: חָ֭מָס אִ֣ישׁ יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·mās ’îš yə·p̄at·teh rê·‘ê·hū wə·hō·w·lî·ḵōw bə·ḏe·reḵ lō- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path [that is] not good

verses.original: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ṣeh ‘ê·nāw laḥ·šōḇ tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ qō·rêṣ śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw kil·lāh rā·‘āh
verses.literal: He who winks his eye devises perversity he who purses his lips is bent on evil

verses.original: שֵׂיבָ֑ה עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תִּמָּצֵֽא׃ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: śê·ḇāh ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ tip̄·’e·reṯ tim·mā·ṣê bə·ḏe·reḵ ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Gray hair [is] a crown of glory it is attained along the path of righteousness

verses.original: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם ט֤וֹב מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim ṭō·wḇ mig·gib·bō·wr ū·mō·šêl bə·rū·ḥōw mil·lō·ḵêḏ ‘îr
verses.literal: [He who is] slow to anger [is] better than a warrior and he who controls his temper [is greater] than one who captures a city

verses.original: הַגּוֹרָ֑ל יוּטַ֣ל אֶת־ בַּ֭חֵיק כָּל־ מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃ וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·rāl yū·ṭal ’eṯ- ba·ḥêq kāl- miš·pā·ṭōw Yah·weh
verses.literal: The lot is cast - into the lap but its every decision is from the LORD
